title: ironwork-fuzz/v1
description: DIR/manifest.json, which ironwork fuzz writes for a fuzz run and cobolwork's abend set reads (docs/evidence.md section 5).

format.description: The manifest's shape: a key added keeps it, a key removed, renamed or given another meaning takes a new one.

version.description: The ironwork release that wrote the manifest.

seed.description: The --seed the inputs were generated from; the same seed gives the same runs.

strategy.description: How inputs are generated: field by field from the record and parameter descriptions.

clock.description: The time every run's clock was fixed at, --clock or 2026-01-01.

file.description: The program, or for a job the JCL, by path from --root, the current directory without it.

id.description: The PROGRAM-ID, or for a job the job's name.

roots.description: The directories the runs read, numbered as a journal's input records number them: the program's directory, then each -I and -L library; for a job, the JCL's directory, .work for each run's own data sets, the libraries, then the procedure libraries.

items.description: A root by its path from --root, . for --root itself, null for one outside it.

entry.description: How each run was made: ironwork run, ironwork job (--job) or ironwork cics (--cics).

inputs.description: The inputs of the kept runs.

counts.description: Outcomes over the generated runs; an abend that says what the surroundings lack counts as refused.

clean.description: Runs that ended without an abend.

abend.description: Runs that ended in an abend the input may have caused.

refused.description: Runs that say nothing of the program's input: ironwork refused them, panicked, or the abend names what the surroundings lack.

input.description: One input of a kept run.

id.description: The id a run's input array names it by.

kind.description: Where it goes in: a DD's data set, SYSIN lines, a PARM, a CICS COMMAREA, or a terminal's screen script.

name.description: The name it goes in under: a DD name, SYSIN, PARM, DFHCOMMAREA or the terminal id; for a job, a data set name, STEP.DD or a step.

bytes.description: Its bytes in base64, possibly empty; a COMMAREA's in EBCDIC, a PARM's and a screen script's in UTF-8.

minimized.description: False when minimizing ran out of runs before the input was as small as still gives the abend.

run.description: A kept run: its inputs, its abend, and the journal and coverage of its run with --evidence.

abend.description: The abend the run ended with.

code.description: The abend code: S0C7, U4038, ASRA, S322, S806 and so on.

file.description: The source it ended in, relative to the root that supplied it.

message.description: The message the run ended with.

optimized.description: Whether the same input, compiled with OPTIMIZE(2), ends in the same abend at the same file and line. True without a run for S322 and S806, which OPTIMIZE cannot change.

journal.description: The run id of its journal under evidence/runs.

coverage.description: Its coverage, in run --coverage's format, by path from DIR.

limit.description: The statement limit the run was given (run --statement-limit): a kept S322's place depends on it. Absent for a run with no limit.
